heading: INT. RUINED OPERA HOUSE - STALLS - DAY

units.text: INT. RUINED OPERA HOUSE - STALLS - DAY
Roof gone.
Rain falls on velvet seats.
A chandelier lies shattered across the orchestra pit.
Distant artillery thumps.
SERGEANT OKONKWO (40s, broad, helmet strap chewed) crouches at the edge of the stage with his rifle.
Hand signals.
Behind him in the stalls, four soldiers go low between the seat rows.
CORPORAL LINDQVIST (20s, pale, glasses taped at the hinge) scans the balcony.
PRIVATE BAPTISTE (19, carrying the radio) hunches under the pit rail.
MEDIC TRAN (30s, red cross on a torn sleeve) drags a bag across the aisle.
Okonkwo signals: two fingers, left.
They move.
He moves with them.
A cough from the stage-right curtain.
All five freeze.
Rifles swing as one.
A figure staggers out.
Wounded.
Uniform from the wrong side, no helmet, hands raised, one hand red to the wrist.
Please. Please.
units.name: WOUNDED SOLDIER

units.text: Down! On your knees!
units.name: OKONKWO

units.text: He drops.
Tran crosses the gap in three strides and tears his sleeve open.
He grips her wrist; she shoves it away.
Hold still.
units.name: TRAN

units.text: Petrescu. Mihai Petrescu.
units.name: WOUNDED SOLDIER

units.text: Where's your unit?
units.name: OKONKWO

units.text: Gone. Gone. Under the stairs. They are coming for the radio.
units.name: PETRESCU

units.text: Baptiste hugs the radio set to his chest.
Lindqvist spins toward the exits.
A shell lands somewhere close and plaster rains from the proscenium.
ACHTERBERG (20s, sniper, scope cap between his teeth) is up in the dress circle, rifle braced on a brass rail.
Movement in the lobby! Boots on marble!
units.name: ACHTERBERG

units.text: How many?
units.name: LINDQVIST

units.text: Twelve. Fifteen. They have a mortar.
units.name: PETRESCU

units.text: Baptiste, call it in. Tran, he walks or he stays. Lindqvist, left aisle.
units.name: OKONKWO

units.text: They break in four directions.
Petrescu pulls himself up by the stage rail and Tran props him by the belt.
Together they go, stumbling, toward the pit door.
A second shell.
The chandelier trembles in the rubble and a single crystal drops, ringing, across the stone.
